title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP QHora-322 miro_webserver_controllers_api_login_singIn Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of QNAP QHora-322 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the miro_webserver_controllers_api_login_singIn function. The issue results from allowing a user to authenticate using an arbitrary QCloud account. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
